chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from al-Husayn ibn Abi al-A'ala, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) was a meat-lover; he loved meat.
ai.seo_question: Did the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) like eating meat?
ai.summary: This concise hadith from Al-Kafi highlights the Prophet Muhammad’s (peace be upon him and his family) natural inclination towards meat, reflecting the Sunnah of enjoying permissible (halal) foods without asceticism. In Shia scholarly tradition, this is often cited to demonstrate the Prophet’s balanced lifestyle and to validate the consumption of meat as a source of strength and nourishment, countering later ascetic trends that might view it with suspicion.
